hypothesis: A post-only bid backed by an independently certified lower fair-value bound may retain a small neglected-market residual after queue delay, exit fees, one adverse tick and observed post-fill toxicity. Generic market making without a fair-value bound is excluded.
accepted_fair_sources: resolver-boundary residual from the unchanged H43 rule or a separately frozen resolver arm
content-addressed deterministic payoff proof with current rule certification
exact-expiry or bounded total-variance options surface with a complete bid/ask IV envelope
content-addressed cross-venue payoff relation with synchronized books

selection.candidate_condition: the taker route does not clear its conservative hurdle, but a non-crossing post-only price leaves a positive lower-bound residual after all registered stresses
excluded: directional bids based only on midpoint, last trade, imbalance or volume
reward estimates without reconstructible score share
scheduled catalyst windows without a category-specific fair feed
unknown fees, tick size, minimum size, rules or resolver

execution.queue_model: back of displayed queue plus one venue-minimum order; cancellations never improve simulated priority
execution.costs: two times current fees, one adverse tick on unwind, full displayed-depth walk and a full failure-risk reserve
execution.rewards: zero unless authenticated attribution and competitor score share are reconstructible

evaluation.independent_unit: first eligible fair-source signal per condition and UTC day
evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across fair source, category, side and latency profile
evaluation.null_outcome: No eligible quotes or negative post-fill markout is a valid rejection; thresholds must not be retuned on this cohort.
